svg.title: Anatomy of a cosigned checkpoint
svg.desc: A checkpoint is a signed note. Its text has three lines: the origin naming the log, the tree size, and the root hash in base64. A blank line separates it from the signature lines. Each signature line is an em dash, the key name, and base64 of a 4-byte key ID followed by the signature. A witness cosignature line also carries an 8-byte timestamp before its signature.

text.tspan: (blank line: the text ends at the last one)
